content.short: Connecting crypto and real assets on Cardano, merging government regulation with decentralization.
content.description:
Hypercube is a project that combines crypto projects with real-world ventures. On the traditional side, the project has specific government permissions to operate legally, using Cardano's blockchain technology to tokenize real-world assets like equity and other debt securities.

Additionally, it offers the possibility for ordinary people to purchase native Cardano tokens beyond ADA. On the decentralized side, the project provides access for the entire Cardano community to secure assets from the traditional financial market, serving as the primary hub for trading native Cardano tokens
